# docstube

> Verified docs, generated from your code.

## Docs
- [CLI reference](/cli-reference/): Command reference for the docstube CLI, including generation, refresh, verification, status, plugin, and upgrade commands.
- [Configuration](/configuration/): Configure the docstube config family, agents, versions, locales, components, plugins, and comment-preserving edits.
- [Getting started](/getting-started/): Install docstube, open the setup wizard, and generate your first verified docs site.
- [CI and the GitHub Action](/github-action/): Run docstube in GitHub Actions, open verified documentation PRs, deliver flags, and gate auto-merge from the committed manifest.
- [How verification works](/how-verification-works/): How docstube assigns guarantee levels, runs built-in verifier checks, grounds claims, retries failed drafts, and keeps unresolved risk visible as flags.
- [Writing plugins](/writing-plugins/): Build docstube plugins with @docstube/plugin-sdk, registration hooks, permissions, plugin loading, and the plugin-authoring scaffold.
